@NativeType("struct cl_mutable_dispatch_config_khr") public class CLMutableDispatchConfigKHR extends Struct<CLMutableDispatchConfigKHR> implements NativeResource
struct cl_mutable_dispatch_config_khr {
    cl_mutable_command_khr command;
    cl_uint num_args;

    size_t const * local_work_size;
}
